method: Use a campground-specific Google Maps destination when the park contains a distinct named campground; otherwise use the exact named park destination corroborated by the current Washington State Parks address or published locate point. Seattle estimates use no-ferry routes for the Olympic Peninsula and ordinary fastest routes elsewhere, then round up for normal traffic variation.

reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps exact named park destination matched to the Washington State Parks address and published locate point
reviews.route_note: Uses the no-ferry I-5 and Tacoma Narrows route; ferry options may be shorter but add fare, queue, and sailing-time uncertainty.
